verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. S1 no longer treats arbitrary retained command arguments as execution: invocations are classified by command position or a narrow interpreter allowlist, quoted spans are masked, inline `-c` bodies are rejected, and the mutation table now includes the previously requested successful `test -n '<required text>'` bypass plus unquoted non-interpreter data and quoted interpreter-argument cases. The remaining interpreter-argv ambiguity is explicitly and consistently disclosed as a limitation rather than overclaimed as proof of execution. The lane-level S3 coverage and S2 waiver checks remain coherent, and the added tests exercise the real checker path through `check_tree`. No correctness, soundness, vacuity, or security defect requiring changes was found in the supplied diff.
